classificationRules.EXACT: result, error, logs, compute units, compared lamport/token post-balances, inner instructions and return data are exact
classificationRules.HIGH_FIDELITY: result/error and inner instructions exact; log LCS similarity >= 0.95; CU difference <= 1%; compared lamport/token balances exact
classificationRules.PARTIAL: result/error exact, but one or more fidelity signals miss high-fidelity thresholds
classificationRules.FAILED: result or canonical transaction error differs
classificationRules.UNSUPPORTED: bundle lacks defensible historical pre-state even if an attempted replay happens to match
